defs.ThingDef/HH_ProjectorScreen.label: projector screen
defs.ThingDef/HH_ProjectorScreen.description: A wide screen with a projector bolted to the ceiling beam above it. Put chairs in front of it, a venue sign in the room and the lights down: guests pay for a seat and colonists get a movie night. The films are old, loud and nobody remembers who made them.
defs.ThingDef/HH_SalonChair.label: salon chair
defs.ThingDef/HH_SalonChair.description: A padded, height-adjustable chair with a cape, a mirror on the wall behind it and a drawer of scissors. A colonist standing behind it gives the person in the chair a new look. Colonists use it for free; guests pay.
defs.ThingDef/HH_ParkBench.label: park bench
defs.ThingDef/HH_ParkBench.description: A plain bench for two with a view. Nothing to buy, nothing to sign: people sit down, look at whatever there is to look at, and feel a little better for it. The prettier the surroundings, the better.
defs.ThingDef/HH_TaxiStand.label: taxi stand
defs.ThingDef/HH_TaxiStand.description: A painted square of ground, a signpost and a callbox. Departing guests who would rather not walk to the map edge hail a small shuttle here and pay for the ride; some arriving guests are dropped off at the stand in style. Needs open sky above it so the cab can land.

defs.ThoughtDef/HH_WatchedMovie.stages.0.desc: I sat in the dark with a bag of something crunchy and watched people with better problems than mine.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ScreeningAttended.stages.0: Everybody on one side of the room, one screen on the other. We had a good evening.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_FreshLook.stages.0.label: fresh look
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_FreshLook.stages.0.descrip: New hair. Same person, but the mirror disagrees.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AdmiredArt.stages.0.label: admired some art
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AdmiredArt.stages.0.descri: Somebody made these with their hands. I stood there for a while and did not mind.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ParkRested.stages.0.label: sat in the open
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ParkRested.stages.0.descri: A bench, some air, a view. It is not much but it was enough.

defs.GatheringDef/HH_Screening.label: movie night
defs.GatheringDef/HH_Screening.letterText: {ORGANIZER_labelShort} has talked the colony into a movie night. Everyone who sits down in front of the screen will gain recreation and a good evening's worth of mood.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_CityLife_1.label: city life
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_CityLife_1.descrip: Projector screens for a proper cinema, styling chairs for a proper salon, and the know-how to charge admission to a room full of art. Strangers will pay surprising sums for a haircut and a seat in the dark.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_CityLife_2.label: taxi and bodyguards
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_CityLife_2.descrip: A taxi stand where small shuttles pick guests up and set them down, and a bodyguard service for guests with more money than caution. Needs a working idea of how to land things on purpose.
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Cinema.desc: A dark room with a projector screen and plenty of chairs. Guests buy a ticket for the next screening; a screening runs for as long as the film does and nobody gets a refund for falling asleep. Needs a powered projector screen and at least a few seats in front of it.
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Salon.label: beauty salon
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Salon.descr: A room with salon chairs. Guests pay for a haircut, a new style, a dye job or, with the right ideology, a tattoo; a colonist with the serving work type does the work. Without anyone to serve, the salon is closed.
defs.Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Gallery.des: A room full of sculptures, hung in good light. Guests pay a small entry fee and walk past the pieces one by one; the more beautiful the art, the happier they leave. Needs a handful of artworks in the room.
